candidate: candidate-01 v37 quarter-hour algorithmic auction continuation
research_question: Does a cost-resolved first-ten-second displacement at a standardized quarter-hour boundary, followed by completed one-minute acceptance outside a prior two-sided dealing range, continue toward the nearest causally confirmed unswept external five-minute swing liquidity more reliably than the identical event at ordinary five-minute boundaries?

economic_logic.liquidity_formation: The immediately preceding 15 completed UTC minutes must form a two-sided dealing range with at least two completed-close midpoint crossings and width of at least four per-side cost units.
economic_logic.algorithmic_clock: The source paper documents concentration of trade count, dollar volume, volatility and directional order-flow information in the first ten seconds of quarter-hour boundaries on Binance perpetual futures. The clock is treated as a structural coordination mechanism, not a profitable signal by itself.
economic_logic.liquidity_collection: The first ten seconds must open inside the frozen range and close at least one 7-bp all-in per-side cost beyond one boundary with aligned aggressive flow.
economic_logic.acceptance: The entire boundary minute must close beyond the same cost-resolved boundary with aligned aggregate aggressive flow. Entry waits until the first later official futures TradeTick.
economic_logic.destination: The nearest causally confirmed, still-unswept five-minute swing liquidity level beyond the signal-minute extreme, searched only in the prior 72 hours.
economic_logic.invalidation: Completed reacceptance through dealing-range equilibrium; the fixed protective stop is one 7-bp cost buffer beyond the frozen midpoint.
economic_logic.cost_constraint: The paper does not establish an immediately tradable edge and its average ten-second effect is smaller than round-trip costs. Therefore the candidate does not trade clock activity without cost-resolved displacement, minute acceptance and an external liquidity destination. NautilusTrader retains the existing cost-dominated and net-reward-risk gates.

pattern_scenario_separation.pattern_detector: detect_clock_auction_pattern emits only the frozen dealing range, first-ten-second displacement and completed-minute acceptance observation.
pattern_scenario_separation.scenario_router: route_pattern finds a confirmed unswept external swing, maps midpoint invalidation and external destination, and labels quarter-hour versus ordinary five-minute clock class.
pattern_scenario_separation.execution: run_nautilus_tick_plan_backtest receives completed plans and official aggregate trades represented one-for-one as TradeTicks; NautilusTrader exclusively owns orders, fills, commissions, margin, positions, PnL and NAV.

data_contract.source: Official Binance Vision daily BTCUSDT USD-M futures aggTrades archives
data_contract.integrity: Every ZIP must match its published SHA-256 CHECKSUM before parsing.
data_contract.timestamp_normalization: Exchange timestamps are normalized to nanoseconds by the existing authoritative aggTrade adapter.
data_contract.clock: Exact UTC minute and ten-second boundaries. The impulse is [minute start, +10 seconds); the scenario is not available until the complete boundary minute ends.
data_contract.execution_stream: Official aggregate trades are represented one-for-one as NautilusTrader TradeTicks.

frozen_parameters.minimum_balance_width_basis: Four times 7 bps; not PnL fitted.
frozen_parameters.minimum_displacement_basis: One frozen all-in per-side cost; not PnL fitted.

week_selection.pool: Every UTC Monday from 2020-01-06 through 2025-12-29 inclusive with official BTCUSDT USD-M archive eligibility.
week_selection.algorithm: For every eligible Monday compute SHA256(seed + '|' + ISO-date), sort lexicographically by full digest, and take the first three.
week_selection.staging: Run week 1 only. Week 2 opens only after the unchanged primary weekly gate and quarter-hour/control discrimination comparison advance. Week 3 opens only after the unchanged week-2 gate and discrimination comparison advance.

operational: checksum, exact-clock, swing-confirmation and causality assertions
weekly_gate.ablation_discrimination_required: Primary must have at least seven trades and strictly improve win rate, total return, geometric daily return, profit factor and maximum drawdown over the ordinary-five-minute control.

long_evaluation_policy: Closed until all three frozen BTC weeks advance unchanged. ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT remain closed until BTC demonstrates repeatable post-cost alpha.

research_basis.source: Kim and Hansen, The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures, arXiv:2607.09426 (2026)
research_basis.supported_point: Binance perpetual futures show first-ten-second quarter-hour bursts and directional order-flow information for later returns.

research_basis.source: Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov, The Price Impact of Order Book Events, Journal of Financial Econometrics (2014)
research_basis.supported_point: Directional aggressive-flow imbalance is required alongside price displacement.
USD-M aggTrades schemas, daily archives and per-file checksums.

prohibited_adaptations_after_week_1: Changing any clock, range, displacement, swing, stop, target, hold, risk or cost parameter because of week-1 PnL
Adding session, volatility, direction or score filters to rescue the candidate
Replacing the external-liquidity target with an arbitrary fixed reward-risk target
Running a long period after a failed first-week gate
